scenes.text:
[b]Seven days ago, three fragments of something fell burning through Vesper's sky.[/b]

The survey ship [i]Meridian[/i] holds station overhead. Below, on the dead colony's crash field, Camp Halcyon strings its lanterns against the indigo dark.

The fragments broadcast a signal. It rewrites small things first: compass needles. Then memories. Then the sky.

You go down at dawn. What you bring back up is up to you.
scenes.title: STARFALL MYTHOS
